extraction: Extract all per-seed tar.gz files of a partition into the same parent. The repeated RUN_INDEX is byte-identical; all input/output/readback/log files then reconstruct the original partition tree.
large_file_style: regular tracked per-seed tar.gz, matching existing repository archive convention; no raw field bag/video

supplemental_logs.purpose: wrapper command logs, contracts, dependency log and preserved v1 readouts; not new trials
